title: 30. Câu tường thuật

intro.text: Bài 30 — Câu tường thuật (reported/indirect speech). Làm câu hỏi ngay, mở toggle để kiểm tra. Cuối bài có Mini Test 16 câu.
Trọng tâm TOEIC: Part 5 & 6 — lùi thì, đổi đại từ và trạng từ thời gian; tường thuật câu hỏi và mệnh lệnh.

parts.heading: Phần 1 · Lùi thì khi tường thuật
theory: Khi động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ (said, told), lùi thì một bậc: hiện tại đơn→quá khứ đơn, hiện tại tiếp diễn→quá khứ tiếp diễn, hiện tại hoàn thành/quá khứ đơn→quá khứ hoàn thành, will→would, can→could, may→might.
keys: "I am busy" → He said (that) he was busy. "I will call" → She said she would call.
traps: Lùi thì khi câu dẫn ở quá khứ; will→would, can→could, must→had to.
examples: "We are hiring." → They said they were hiring.
"I will send it." → He said he would send it.

questions.q:
"The report is ready." → She said the report ___ ready.
A. is    B. was    C. will be    D. has been
questions.a: Đáp án: B (was). ||Lùi thì: is → was.

questions.q:
"We will deliver tomorrow." → They said they ___ deliver the next day.
A. will    B. would    C. can    D. do
questions.a: Đáp án: B (would). ||Lùi thì: will → would.

questions.q:
"I can finish it." → He said he ___ finish it.
A. can    B. could    C. will    D. must
questions.a: Đáp án: B (could). ||Lùi thì: can → could.

questions.q:
"The team is working hard." → The manager said the team ___ working hard.
A. is    B. was    C. will be    D. has been
questions.a: Đáp án: B (was). ||Lùi thì: is working → was working.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"She said she will attend the meeting."
questions.a: Lỗi: "will" → "would". ||Câu dẫn quá khứ (said) → lùi thì will → would.

questions.q:
"We have completed the audit." → They said they ___ the audit.
A. have completed    B. had completed    C. complete    D. will complete
questions.a: Đáp án: B (had completed). ||Lùi thì: have completed → had completed.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. He said that he is tired.
B. He said that he was tired.
C. He said that he will be tired.
D. He said that he tired.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||Lùi thì: is → was.

questions.q:
Điền vào tường thuật (Part 6):
"The director said the project ___ on schedule."
A. is    B. was    C. will be    D. has been
questions.a: Đáp án: B (was). ||Lùi thì: is → was.

parts.heading: Phần 2 · Đổi đại từ và trạng từ thời gian/nơi chốn
theory: Khi tường thuật, đổi đại từ theo ngữ cảnh và đổi trạng từ chỉ thời gian/nơi chốn.
keys: now→then, today→that day, tomorrow→the next day, yesterday→the day before, this→that, here→there, ago→before.
traps: tomorrow → the following/next day; yesterday → the previous day/the day before.

questions.q:
"I will call you tomorrow." → He said he would call me ___.
A. tomorrow    B. the next day    C. yesterday    D. now
questions.a: Đáp án: B (the next day). ||tomorrow → the next/following day.

questions.q:
"We finished it yesterday." → They said they had finished it ___.
A. yesterday    B. the day before    C. tomorrow    D. now
questions.a: Đáp án: B (the day before). ||yesterday → the day before/the previous day.

questions.q:
"I am busy now." → She said she was busy ___.
A. now    B. then    C. today    D. here
questions.a: Đáp án: B (then). ||now → then.

questions.q:
"This is my office." → He said ___ was his office.
A. this    B. that    C. these    D. it here
questions.a: Đáp án: B (that). ||this → that.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"She said she would arrive here the next day." (tường thuật từ xa)
questions.a: Lỗi: "here" → "there". ||Khi tường thuật từ nơi khác, here → there.

questions.q:
"We launched it two days ago." → They said they had launched it two days ___.
A. ago    B. before    C. later    D. now
questions.a: Đáp án: B (before). ||ago → before.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. He said he would send it tomorrow.
B. He said he would send it the following day.
C. He said he will send it the next day.
D. He said he sends it tomorrow.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||Lùi thì (would) + tomorrow → the following day.

questions.q:
Điền vào tường thuật (Part 6):
"The manager announced that the office would be closed ___."
A. tomorrow    B. the following day    C. yesterday    D. now
questions.a: Đáp án: B (the following day). ||tomorrow → the following day.

parts.heading: Phần 3 · Tường thuật câu hỏi
theory: Tường thuật câu hỏi: dùng asked + (tân ngữ) + từ hỏi/if/whether + TRẬT TỰ KHẲNG ĐỊNH + lùi thì.
keys: "Where do you work?" → He asked where I worked. "Are you ready?" → She asked if I was ready.
traps: Bỏ do/does/did, dùng trật tự khẳng định; câu Yes/No dùng if/whether.

questions.q:
"Where do you work?" → He asked where I ___.
A. work    B. worked    C. do work    D. am working
questions.a: Đáp án: B (worked). ||Tường thuật câu hỏi: trật tự khẳng định + lùi thì.

questions.q:
"Are you ready?" → She asked ___ I was ready.
A. if    B. what    C. that    D. who
questions.a: Đáp án: A (if). ||Câu hỏi Yes/No → if/whether.

questions.q:
"When will the order ship?" → They asked when the order ___ ship.
A. will    B. would    C. does    D. can
questions.a: Đáp án: B (would). ||Lùi thì: will → would; trật tự khẳng định.

questions.q:
"Did you submit the form?" → He asked if I ___ the form.
A. submit    B. had submitted    C. did submit    D. will submit
questions.a: Đáp án: B (had submitted). ||Yes/No → if; lùi thì (did submit → had submitted).

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"She asked me where did I live."
questions.a: Lỗi: "where did I live" → "where I lived". ||Bỏ 'did', trật tự khẳng định, lùi thì.

questions.q:
"What time does it open?" → He asked what time it ___.
A. opens    B. opened    C. does open    D. will open
questions.a: Đáp án: B (opened). ||Lùi thì + trật tự khẳng định.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. He asked whether I was available.
B. He asked whether was I available.
C. He asked whether do I available.
D. He asked whether am I available.
questions.a: Đáp án: A. ||whether + trật tự khẳng định + lùi thì (was).

questions.q:
Điền vào tường thuật (Part 6):
"The client asked whether the product ___ in stock."
A. is    B. was    C. will be    D. be
questions.a: Đáp án: B (was). ||Lùi thì: is → was.

parts.heading: Phần 4 · Tường thuật mệnh lệnh và động từ tường thuật
theory: Tường thuật mệnh lệnh: told/asked + tân ngữ + (not) to + V. Dùng động từ tường thuật phù hợp: tell, ask, advise, remind, warn, offer, promise, suggest.
keys: "Submit it now." → He told me to submit it. "Don't be late." → She told us not to be late. suggest + V-ing/that...
traps: say không có tân ngữ trực tiếp (say to me); tell + tân ngữ (tell me). Mệnh lệnh phủ định: not to + V.

questions.q:
"Please submit the report." → The manager asked me ___ the report.
A. submit    B. to submit    C. submitting    D. submitted
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to submit). ||Tường thuật mệnh lệnh: ask + sb + to V.

questions.q:
"Don't be late." → She told us ___ late.
A. not be    B. not to be    C. to not be    D. don't be
questions.a: Đáp án: B (not to be). ||Mệnh lệnh phủ định: tell + sb + not to + V.

questions.q:
"Remember to back up the files." → He reminded me ___ the files.
A. back up    B. to back up    C. backing up    D. backed up
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to back up). ||remind + sb + to V.

questions.q:
Chọn động từ phù hợp:
"I will help you." → He ___ to help me.
A. said    B. told    C. offered    D. asked
questions.a: Đáp án: C (offered). ||'I will help' = lời đề nghị giúp đỡ → offered to V.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"He said me to wait outside."
questions.a: Lỗi: "said me" → "told me". ||say không đi với tân ngữ gián tiếp; dùng tell + sb + to V.

questions.q:
"You should take a break." → She advised me ___ a break.
A. take    B. to take    C. taking    D. took
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to take). ||advise + sb + to V.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. The supervisor told the staff to wear helmets.
B. The supervisor said the staff to wear helmets.
C. The supervisor told to the staff wear helmets.
D. The supervisor told the staff wearing helmets.
questions.a: Đáp án: A. ||tell + sb + to V.

questions.q:
Điền vào tường thuật (Part 6):
"The trainer warned the participants ___ touch the equipment without permission."
A. not to    B. to not    C. don't    D. not
questions.a: Đáp án: A (not to). ||warn + sb + not to + V.

parts.heading: Phần 5 · Luyện trộn nhanh (10 câu)
theory: Trộn lùi thì, đổi trạng từ, tường thuật câu hỏi và mệnh lệnh.

questions.q:
"The shipment is delayed." → They said the shipment ___ delayed.
A. is    B. was    C. will be    D. has been
questions.a: Đáp án: B (was). ||Lùi thì: is → was.

questions.q:
"I will email you tomorrow." → She said she would email me ___.
A. tomorrow    B. the next day    C. yesterday    D. now
questions.a: Đáp án: B (the next day). ||tomorrow → the next day.

questions.q:
"Where is the manager?" → He asked where the manager ___.
A. is    B. was    C. does be    D. will be
questions.a: Đáp án: B (was). ||Lùi thì + trật tự khẳng định.

questions.q:
"Please sign here." → The agent asked me ___ there.
A. sign    B. to sign    C. signing    D. signed
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to sign). ||Tường thuật mệnh lệnh: ask + sb + to V; here → there.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"He said he will call me the next day."
questions.a: Lỗi: "will" → "would". ||Câu dẫn quá khứ → lùi thì will → would.

questions.q:
"Don't share the password." → IT told us ___ the password.
A. not share    B. not to share    C. to not share    D. don't share
questions.a: Đáp án: B (not to share). ||Mệnh lệnh phủ định: not to + V.

questions.q:
"Have you finished?" → She asked ___ I had finished.
A. if    B. what    C. that    D. who
questions.a: Đáp án: A (if). ||Câu hỏi Yes/No → if; lùi thì (had finished).

questions.q:
"We can deliver by Friday." → They said they ___ deliver by Friday.
A. can    B. could    C. will    D. do
questions.a: Đáp án: B (could). ||Lùi thì: can → could.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. She told me to not be late.
B. She told me not to be late.
C. She said me not to be late.
D. She told me not be late.
questions.a: Đáp án: B. ||tell + sb + not to + V.

questions.q:
Điền vào tường thuật (Part 6):
"The manager reminded the team ___ the deadline."
A. meet    B. to meet    C. meeting    D. met
questions.a: Đáp án: B (to meet). ||remind + sb + to V.

minitest.heading: 🏋️ Bài luyện tập tổng hợp (Mini Test · 16 câu)
minitest.note: Làm liên tục 16 câu, gợi ý 8–10 phút, KHÔNG mở đáp án giữa chừng. Mục tiêu: đúng từ 13/16 trở lên.

questions.q:
"The report is ready." → She said the report ___ ready.
A. is    B. was    C. will be    D. has been
questions.a: B (was). ||Lùi thì: is → was.

questions.q:
"We will start tomorrow." → They said they would start ___.
A. tomorrow    B. the next day    C. yesterday    D. now
questions.a: B (the next day). ||tomorrow → the next day.

questions.q:
"Where do you work?" → He asked where I ___.
A. work    B. worked    C. do work    D. am working
questions.a: B (worked). ||Tường thuật câu hỏi: trật tự khẳng định + lùi thì.

questions.q:
"Please submit the form." → The clerk asked me ___ the form.
A. submit    B. to submit    C. submitting    D. submitted
questions.a: B (to submit). ||Mệnh lệnh: ask + sb + to V.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"She said she will attend the meeting."
questions.a: Lỗi: "will" → "would". ||Câu dẫn quá khứ → lùi thì.

questions.q:
"I can finish it today." → He said he ___ finish it that day.
A. can    B. could    C. will    D. must
questions.a: B (could). ||Lùi thì: can → could; today → that day.

questions.q:
"Are you available?" → She asked ___ I was available.
A. if    B. what    C. that    D. who
questions.a: A (if). ||Yes/No → if/whether + lùi thì.

questions.q:
"Don't touch the machine." → The supervisor told us ___ the machine.
A. not touch    B. not to touch    C. to not touch    D. don't touch
questions.a: B (not to touch). ||Mệnh lệnh phủ định: not to + V.

questions.q:
Chọn câu ĐÚNG:
A. He said me to wait here.
B. He told me to wait there.
C. He told to me wait there.
D. He said me wait here.
questions.a: B. ||tell + sb + to V; here → there.

questions.q:
"We have completed the project." → They said they ___ the project.
A. have completed    B. had completed    C. complete    D. will complete
questions.a: B (had completed). ||Lùi thì: have completed → had completed.

questions.q:
Tìm và sửa lỗi:
"He asked me where did I park the car."
questions.a: Lỗi: "where did I park" → "where I had parked". ||Bỏ 'did', trật tự khẳng định, lùi thì.

questions.q:
"You should rest." → The doctor advised him ___.
A. rest    B. to rest    C. resting    D. rested
questions.a: B (to rest). ||advise + sb + to V.

questions.q:
"When will it arrive?" → She asked when it ___ arrive.
A. will    B. would    C. does    D. can
questions.a: B (would). ||Lùi thì: will → would.

questions.q:
"I will help you." → He ___ to help me.
A. said    B. told    C. offered    D. asked
questions.a: C (offered). ||Lời đề nghị giúp → offered to V.

questions.q:
"This is the final version." → She said ___ was the final version.
A. this    B. that    C. these    D. it here
questions.a: B (that). ||this → that.

questions.q:
Điền vào tường thuật (Part 6):
"The manager announced that the office would be closed ___ due to maintenance."
A. tomorrow    B. the following day    C. yesterday    D. now
questions.a: B (the following day). ||tomorrow → the following day.

summary: Lùi thì khi động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ: hiện tại→quá khứ, hiện tại hoàn thành/quá khứ→quá khứ hoàn thành, will→would, can→could, must→had to.
Đổi trạng từ: now→then, today→that day, tomorrow→the next/following day, yesterday→the day before, this→that, here→there, ago→before.
Tường thuật câu hỏi: asked + (tân ngữ) + từ hỏi/if/whether + TRẬT TỰ KHẲNG ĐỊNH + lùi thì (bỏ do/does/did).
Tường thuật mệnh lệnh: tell/ask + sb + (not) to + V. tell + sb (có tân ngữ), say + (to sb). Động từ: advise, remind, warn, offer, suggest.

summary_callouts.text: Bẫy: 'said me' SAI → 'told me'. Tường thuật câu hỏi dùng trật tự khẳng định (where I worked, không 'where did I work'). will→would khi lùi thì.
Sau khi làm xong: nếu đúng dưới 13/16, đổi Trạng thái bài thành "Cần ôn" và làm lại Phần 1 (lùi thì) sau 1 ngày.
